name: exploded-v60-pareto-26.10-preview-s2-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a V60 pour-over dripper on its glass server, as an SVG. Use the cone dripper with a paper filter rather than a metal mesh filter.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="900" height="1240" viewBox="0 0 900 1240" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="cer" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eee8da"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#fbf8f0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#dcd4c2"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pap" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f3eddd"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#fffdf6"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e7e0cc"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cof" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7c4c22"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#a06e34"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6b3f1b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="gls" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c9d8df"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#f2f7f9"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b7c9d2"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="soft" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="body">
      <path d="M 330,748 L 333,772 C 306,800 283,852 280,908 C 277,972 290,1032 318,1061 A 118 13 0 0 0 542,1061 C 570,1032 583,972 580,908 C 577,852 554,800 527,772 L 530,748 A 100 15 0 0 0 330,748 Z"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="900" height="1240" fill="#faf6ed"/>
  <rect x="16" y="16" width="868" height="1208" rx="10" fill="none" stroke="#e3dac6" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="450" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="3"><tspan fill="#b01e23">V60</tspan><tspan dx="12" fill="#2b2a28">POUR-OVER</tspan></text>
  <rect x="414" y="76" width="72" height="3" fill="#b01e23"/>
  <text x="450" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" letter-spacing="3.5" fill="#8a8578">EXPLODED ASSEMBLY · CONE DRIPPER WITH PAPER FILTER</text>

  <!-- assembly axis -->
  <line x1="430" y1="172" x2="430" y2="1118" stroke="#cdc4b2" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="7 6"/>
  <text x="442" y="1134" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="#a59d8c">assembly axis</text>

  <!-- mate / seating lines -->
  <g stroke="#a9a294" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4">
    <line x1="368" y1="388" x2="316" y2="470"/>
    <line x1="492" y1="388" x2="544" y2="470"/>
    <line x1="430" y1="650" x2="340" y2="742"/>
    <line x1="430" y1="650" x2="520" y2="742"/>
  </g>

  <!-- soft shadows -->
  <ellipse cx="430" cy="414" rx="105" ry="11" fill="#3a352c" opacity="0.10" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <ellipse cx="430" cy="664" rx="90" ry="9" fill="#3a352c" opacity="0.08" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <ellipse cx="430" cy="1088" rx="150" ry="12" fill="#3a352c" opacity="0.10" filter="url(#soft)"/>

  <!-- ============ 1. CERAMIC DRIPPER CONE ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M 280,232 L 366,382 L 494,382 L 580,232 Z" fill="url(#cer)"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="232" rx="150" ry="20" fill="#f2ede2" stroke="#a89f8f" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="232" rx="136" ry="16.5" fill="none" stroke="#d5ccba" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="280" y1="232" x2="366" y2="382" stroke="#a89f8f" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="580" y1="232" x2="494" y2="382" stroke="#a89f8f" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="382" rx="64" ry="11" fill="#f2ede2" stroke="#a89f8f" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="380" rx="42" ry="6.5" fill="#4a4238"/>
    <!-- spiral ribs -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#d0c7b4" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.9">
      <path d="M 302,262 Q 430,280 558,262"/>
      <path d="M 320,294 Q 430,312 540,294"/>
      <path d="M 339,326 Q 430,344 521,326"/>
      <path d="M 357,358 Q 430,376 497,358"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 2. PAPER FILTER ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M 312,478 L 416,632 Q 430,646 444,632 L 548,478 Z" fill="url(#pap)"/>
    <line x1="312" y1="478" x2="418" y2="634" stroke="#b3ab99" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="548" y1="478" x2="442" y2="634" stroke="#b3ab99" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <!-- fold lines -->
    <path d="M 356,494 Q 372,566 416,634" fill="none" stroke="#e6dfcd" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M 430,494 Q 436,568 431,636" fill="none" stroke="#e6dfcd" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- crimped side seam -->
    <path d="M 540,486 Q 478,566 443,628" fill="none" stroke="#e9e1cc" stroke-width="9"/>
    <path d="M 540,486 Q 478,566 443,628" fill="none" stroke="#c6bda4" stroke-width="9" stroke-dasharray="2.5 3.5"/>
    <!-- rim -->
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="478" rx="118" ry="17" fill="#fcf9f1" stroke="#b3ab99" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <path d="M 312,478 A 118 17 0 0 0 548,478" fill="none" stroke="#9c947f" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 3. GLASS SERVER ============ -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="1061" rx="118" ry="13" fill="#e6edf1" opacity="0.9"/>
    <path d="M 330,748 L 333,772 C 306,800 283,852 280,908 C 277,972 290,1032 318,1061 A 118 13 0 0 0 542,1061 C 570,1032 583,972 580,908 C 577,852 554,800 527,772 L 530,748 A 100 15 0 0 0 330,748 Z" fill="url(#gls)" opacity="0.55"/>
    <!-- brewed coffee -->
    <rect x="285" y="858" width="290" height="190" fill="url(#cof)" clip-path="url(#body)"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="858" rx="146" ry="13" fill="#b08048"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="858" rx="146" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#8a5f30" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- glass outline -->
    <path d="M 330,748 L 333,772 C 306,800 283,852 280,908 C 277,972 290,1032 318,1061 A 118 13 0 0 0 542,1061 C 570,1032 583,972 580,908 C 577,852 554,800 527,772 L 530,748 A 100 15 0 0 0 330,748 Z" fill="none" stroke="#6b7f8c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="1059" rx="100" ry="10" fill="none" stroke="#c3d2da" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- neck opening (dark interior) with coffee surface seen inside -->
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="748" rx="100" ry="15" fill="#754a22"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="750" rx="92" ry="12" fill="#96662f"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="748" rx="100" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="#6b7f8c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- dripper seat marking -->
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="748" rx="64" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#a9a294" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
    <!-- pour spout -->
    <path d="M 340,739 C 322,733 306,724 298,716 C 304,732 320,748 342,757 Z" fill="#eef4f7" opacity="0.9" stroke="#6b7f8c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="748" rx="100" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="#6b7f8c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M 548,796 C 644,806 672,880 654,942 C 642,986 606,1010 566,1006 C 590,988 602,964 606,934 C 612,888 594,852 546,840 Z" fill="#e6edf1" opacity="0.8" stroke="#6b7f8c" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <path d="M 638,832 C 656,862 658,910 646,944" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.5"/>
    <!-- glass highlights -->
    <path d="M 300,838 C 293,890 293,952 302,1002" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 556,866 C 562,906 560,946 552,982" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 60 degree wall angle -->
  <g>
    <line x1="272" y1="330" x2="336" y2="330" stroke="#b3a58f" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
    <path d="M 294,330 A 42 42 0 0 1 315,294" fill="none" stroke="#b3a58f" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="304" y="352" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#8a8578">60°</text>
  </g>

  <!-- labels -->
  <g>
    <!-- 1 dripper -->
    <circle cx="549" cy="288" r="2.5" fill="#b7ae9e"/>
    <line x1="549" y1="288" x2="612" y2="288" stroke="#b7ae9e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="630" cy="288" r="13" fill="#b01e23"/>
    <text x="630" y="293" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">1</text>
    <text x="652" y="293" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="1.5" fill="#2b2a28">CERAMIC DRIPPER</text>
    <text x="652" y="312" font-size="12" letter-spacing="0.5" fill="#8a8578">60° walls · spiral ribs · 02 size</text>
    <!-- 2 filter -->
    <circle cx="352" cy="540" r="2.5" fill="#b7ae9e"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="540" x2="312" y2="540" stroke="#b7ae9e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="294" cy="540" r="13" fill="#b01e23"/>
    <text x="294" y="545" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">2</text>
    <text x="272" y="545" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="1.5" fill="#2b2a28">PAPER FILTER</text>
    <text x="272" y="563" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" letter-spacing="0.5" fill="#8a8578">1–4 cup · crimped side seam</text>
    <!-- 3 server -->
    <circle cx="573" cy="1030" r="2.5" fill="#b7ae9e"/>
    <line x1="573" y1="1030" x2="612" y2="1030" stroke="#b7ae9e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="630" cy="1030" r="13" fill="#b01e23"/>
    <text x="630" y="1035" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">3</text>
    <text x="652" y="1035" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="1.5" fill="#2b2a28">GLASS SERVER</text>
    <text x="652" y="1054" font-size="12" letter-spacing="0.5" fill="#8a8578">heatproof glass · 600 ml</text>
    <!-- coffee -->
    <circle cx="296" cy="876" r="2.5" fill="#b7ae9e"/>
    <line x1="296" y1="876" x2="272" y2="876" stroke="#b7ae9e" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="262" y="880" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" letter-spacing="1" fill="#8a8578">BREWED COFFEE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="450" y="1196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12.5" fill="#8a8578">Assembly order: fit the paper filter (2) into the dripper (1), then seat the dripper onto the glass server (3).</text>
</svg>
